heroHeadline: Ortega-Murillo Offer Limited Openings as OAS Foreign Ministers Prepare to Meet Oct. 2
heroSubtitle: With the OAS extraordinary foreign ministers' meeting on Nicaragua set for October 2, Nicaraguan outlet La Prensa says the government is staging limited church and party openings to deflect pressure. The meeting was called by Argentina, Chile, Paraguay, Peru and the US after the Aug. 19 Permanent Council vote (29-1). The UN expert group found on Sept. 22 that the crackdown amounts to crimes against humanity.
